newsitem.title: CHINA: China inviting no foreigners to Deng's funeral.
newsitem.headline: China inviting no foreigners to Deng's funeral.

text.p: No foreign dignitaries will be invited to the funeral of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping in line with national practice, the Funeral Committee announced on Wednesday.

National flags in China's Tiananmen Square at the Great Hall of the People, at some other government buildings and at China's embassies around the world would fly at half-mast "to express the incomparable esteem and profound grief of the whole Party, the whole army and the people", the committee said.

"In accordance with China's practice, foreign governments, political parties and friendly personages will not be invited to send delegations or representatives to attend the mourning activities," the committee said in a statement issued by the official Xinhua news agency.
Deng died of respiratory failure while in the advanced stages of Parkinson's disease on Wednesday night.
